> Every FormHelper functions returns an empty string.

Are you sure? If that was the case most of the FormHelper test cases would be failing. Really doubt the changes would have been merged if that was the case.

It was working, I have made the
update b6cffe63140464c6727116faf2b7d2f609d75ed4 and it doesn't work
anymore...
I have explained to @lorenzo the problem, and he told me to put a ticket.
@ADmad The tests inject directly the templates in the form, this bug might be caused because we broke the helper initialization somehow and it is missing some templates
Ah ok, that could be the issue, can you confirm that file is loaded? Add a die() in the file, for example
Yes, the file is loaded, when I do it, it returns nothing.
@AD7six can you take a look at this?
What is in your templates file?
I can take a look at this. I suspect merging the templates config with the file is wiping the default templates.
